main_text.head: CAP. XII.
De mortuorum in Cruce suspensione.
main_text.p: AC postremò Crux Fine alia, cùm non viui sed mortui in eâ appensi. Notabis. & quodMortuiin Crucem dati. nobis sollenne in rotâ exponere supplicio iam affectos, ad notam sceleris & infamiam, id olim in Cruce, & Orientalibus præsertim. De Romanis nondum lêgi. nisi quòd Cæsar piratas, à quibus captus esset, cùm in deditionem redegisset, quoniam suffixurum se cruci iurauerat, iugulari priùs iussit, atque

page.notes: Left margin notes: "Suetonius cap. XXI" beside the woodcut and "In Neronem" below it; "Suet. cap. LXXXIIII" beside the last paragraph. Woodcut shows a crucified figure with lions and bears; described, not transcribed. Greek line is transcribed as printed with some letters uncertain.
